issues: 六张等大格子，不是 bento；点亮后是白卡压在 #2a2a28 暗底上，暗场品牌段被白块亮瞎
流光是均匀的 4px 琥珀描边 + drop-shadow，点亮辉光是卡外一圈方形外发光
标题是反色的 TitleBlock “Features”，字阶单一
纯色暗底，没有导出时长
changes: 真 bento：两行宽窄互补 600/420/420 ↔ 420/420/600；卡面改暗色出版级 Card，点亮读作通电而非换色
流光改彗星：22% 周长的亮头（6px 高斯辉光 + 2.5px 亮芯）跑一圈，身后留 1.5px 细边，退火到 0.4 常亮；点亮暖光裁在圆角内
标题改为琥珀眉标 PLATFORM + 56px 负字距主标题；描边/弹出/缓推节拍全部保持原值
暗场柔光底（暖色余光）+ 全亮后地面暖光 + 暗角 + 颗粒；补 BENTO_LIGHT_UP_DURATION = 150
issuesEn: Six equal cells, not a bento; lit cards were white slabs on a #2a2a28 background, blinding in a dark brand beat
The light trace was a uniform 4px amber stroke with drop-shadow, and the light-up glow was a square outer halo
The title was an inverted TitleBlock “Features” with a single type size
Flat dark background, and no exported duration
changesEn: A true bento: rows alternate 600/420/420 ↔ 420/420/600; cards use the dark publication-grade Card so lighting up reads as powering on rather than a color swap
The trace is now a comet: a 22%-perimeter bright head (6px Gaussian glow + 2.5px core) runs the loop leaving a 1.5px edge that anneals to 0.4; the warm light-up glow is clipped inside the radius
Title becomes an amber PLATFORM eyebrow plus a 56px tightly tracked headline; trace/pop/push timings are unchanged
Dark soft-lit backdrop with warm tint, a floor glow once all cells are lit, vignette and grain; added BENTO_LIGHT_UP_DURATION = 150
